text:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from SolarWave onboarding call — they raised a few feature asks that feel tied to renewal risk.
Ethan (PM): thanks, can you list them and any urgency/impact?
Maya (CS): short list: per-route billing export, per-environment feature flags visibility for dev/prod, and a safer rollback UI for model rollouts. said they're blocked on cost reconciliation.
Priya (CS Lead): renewal in 6 weeks, SolarWave spends ~250k/mo on inference; if we can't show per-route cost they won't upsell. marking priority: high.
Sam (Product): @Maya can you paste the exact customer wording/examples? we need concrete acceptance criteria to scope.
Maya (CS): pasted notes from the call:
```
Customer: SolarWave (onboarding)
Ask1: export per-route cost CSV (route_id, model, tokens, cost)
Ask2: pipeline visibility: show which features toggled in dev vs prod
Ask3: rollback: one-click revert to stable model for a route (audit trail)
Why: finance can't reconcile charges to product teams -> hold on commitment/upsell
Severity: impacts renewal/expansion conversations
```
Maya (CS): they said they'd happily be a beta for the export if we could deliver in ~3 weeks.
OnboardingBot: New ticket created: CS-4857 "SolarWave - per-route cost export" by Maya (CS).
Priya (CS Lead): can we tie CS-4857 to the customer health score? current health dropped from 88 -> 72 after pricing confusion.
Sam (Product): noted. @Ethan / PM team — propose we triage CS-4857 in next planning sync; if export is quick (1-2 sprints) we ship a light-weight CSV endpoint + UI link.
Ethan (PM): agree. I'll slot a discovery spike this week. Sam, can you own acceptance criteria?
Sam (Product): will do. asking for a few examples of the CSV rows and a sample query. Maya can you attach the sample CSV from the call?
Maya (CS): attaching inline sample they sketched live:
```
route_id,route_name,model,env,tokens_generated,estimated_cost
r-102,checkout,redwood-13b,prod,125000,48.75
r-210,search,open-embed,staging,42000,8.40
```
Maya (CS): also flagged: they want RBAC so finance can't edit routes.
Priya (CS Lead): capture RBAC as part of the ticket but low risk for MVP. main ask is the export + UI link.
Ethan (PM): thanks — I'll create an internal tech task and link to CS-4857.
Maya (CS): I'll follow up with SolarWave to confirm beta acceptance and timeline. :thumbsup:
Sam (Product): perfect — please add any quotes from the customer to the ticket (helps prioritization).
Priya (CS Lead): looping in renewal owner later today.
Maya (CS): will do.
